artworks.title: John Cheney
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: This image is a sketch showing the head and upper shoulders of a person. The person is facing forward with a slightly downcast head. The facial features include a softly rounded face with closed eyes or eyes looking downward, a straight nose, and a relaxed mouth. The hair is medium-length and tousled, framing the face. The clothing sketched suggests a high-collared coat and a necktie or cravat. The background is a plain, unadorned surface. The entire image has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Ventre affamé n'a pas d'orleilles
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals behind a window. The person on the left is leaning forward, with balding hair and an elongated face. The person on the right stands upright, holding a plate. Both wear dark clothing. Outside the window are shutters. Below, there are three figures. On the left, a person with long, tied-back hair plays a stringed instrument. In the center, a figure wearing a tall hat appears to be singing. On the right, another person wearing a top hat plays a flute. They are wearing layered clothes of the era and are in front of a wall sign. The background is a lightly textured backdrop, and the foreground suggests a street setting.

artworks.title: Landscape with Mill
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a rural landscape with a tall, cylindrical tower on a hill. The horizon is low, with the land gently sloping downwards on the right. A large rock or boulder is near the tower. The sketch is monochromatic, using shades of gray to depict the scene. The background is empty, highlighting the solitude of the landscape and the windmill structure.

artworks.title: House and Boat at the Shore
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch of a coastal scene, looking across a beach. There is a thatched-roof cottage on the left, nestled at the bottom of a slope, with smoke coming from the chimney. A tilted boat is on the shoreline to the right of the cottage. The horizon on the right is low above the flat water, and cliffs rise dramatically in the background on the left. The sky above is blank.

artworks.title: Young Woman, Florence [recto]
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The drawing shows a woman seated, leaning slightly forward, with her head gently tilted to the side and downwards. She has delicate facial features with a serene expression, closed or looking down eyes, and softly closed lips. Her hair is styled in an updo, and she wears a form-fitting, long-sleeved dress with visible detailing around the bust and sleeves. Her hands are clasped together in front of her on her lap, and the background is a plain, neutral-toned surface. The drawing is signed with the inscription "Florence 1858" in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Two Women [recto]
artworks.medium: ink wash and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of two women, displayed from the shoulders up. One woman is in a slight profile with her head turned towards the viewer, while the other woman faces forward. Both have soft facial features with serene expressions. Their hair is styled in elegant updos typical of the period, with strands framing their faces. One woman wears a garment with puffed sleeves, while the other woman's clothing is less detailed. The background is a blend of light colors, creating a dream-like atmosphere. No jewelry or objects are present.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person with shoulders and head visible, centrally framed. The individual faces straight, with a direct gaze, delicate facial features, including a rounded face and full lips. They have shoulder-length wavy hair framing their face. The person wears a high-collared coat and a cravat. The background is plain and lightly textured.

artworks.title: Study after "The Enchanted Monarch"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on hand-written letter to Mr. Prang from Frederick Stuart Church
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a handwritten letter with a sketch. The drawing features a handwritten letter that includes a sketch in the upper right corner. The sketch depicts a woman seated and holding a wand, with a lion sitting nearby. The letter is written in cursive handwriting and is addressed to "Mr. Prang." The text refers to an oil painting titled "The Enchanted Monarch," representing a woman with a wand interacting with a lion, which is also depicted in the sketch. The letter is signed by F.S. Church and dated May 8th, 1886.

artworks.title: Mrs. Sylvanus D. Lewis (Estelle Anna Blanche Robinson)
artworks.artist: Seth Wells Cheney, after Charles Loring Elliott
artworks.medium: graphite and charcoal with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a woman depicted from the waist up, seated with her body slightly turned to the left. Her facial features show a calm expression with a slightly upturned gaze, having softly defined eyes and a delicate nose. The woman's hair is styled in loose curls that fall around her shoulders. She is dressed in an off-the-shoulder gown with a patterned trim. The fabric appears to gather around her arms and torso, indicated by the shaded folds. The background of the image is plain.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: charcoal with white chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: This is an image of a grayscale sketch showing only the head of a man. The man's head is drawn in a straightforward position, positioned slightly to the right from the viewer's perspective. His facial features include a smooth complexion with prominent cheeks, strong, slightly curved eyebrows above almond-shaped eyes, firm lips, and a composed expression. His hair appears to be styled back smoothly, with some detailing around the sideburns and hints of curls near the ears. The man's clothing is drawn with minimal detail, but it suggests he is wearing an elegant suit with a high collar and a cravat or necktie. The background is plain, uncluttered, and matches the natural color of the sketching paper. There are no visible accessories or objects with the man. The entire portrait is deliberately understated, focusing attention on the man's face and expression.

artworks.title: Head of a Woman
artworks.medium: charcoal with white chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman from the upper chest up. She is slightly turned to the side, with her head facing to her right. Her features are delicate and she has a gentle expression. She has a small nose and full lips. Her hair is styled in a mid-19th century fashion, with soft waves framing her face and pulled back into a low bun or twist at the back. She wears a simple, light-colored garment with a folded collar or v-neckline. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects in her possession. The background is a plain, light tone.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman
artworks.medium: charcoal with white chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The portrait shows the upper part of the subject's body, focusing on her head and a hint of her shoulders. The individual is in a three-quarter profile position, gazing slightly to the side. She has delicate facial features with a softly defined jawline, straight eyebrows, and a serene expression. Her hair is neatly arranged, pulled back and away from her face, revealing a smooth and tidy hairstyle. The clothing is only faintly visible, with minimal detail. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a smooth, light-colored surface.

artworks.title: Boats at Anchor
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a nautical scene. In the foreground, a boat with a sail down is on calm waters. Another sailboat is visible in the distance, and faint structures are seen along the horizon. The sky blends softly with the horizon, all depicted in light shading and fine lines. The drawing is monochrome, creating a gentle and tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Boys with a Boat
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch showing two figures in a natural setting. The point of view is at eye level, providing a straightforward perspective of the scene. One figure stands with their back turned, while another figure kneels next to a sailboat leaning against a tree. The horizon is suggested by faint lines in the distance. The tree is sparse with a few leaves and branches, surrounded by bushes and hints of distant trees in the background. The drawing style is minimalist with delicate lines outlining the figures and elements. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey on off-white paper.

artworks.title: Boy on a Ladder
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person on a ladder. The figure is seen sitting on the ladder in profile, with legs bent and feet on a rung. One hand grips the ladder. The person wears a wide-brimmed hat, a long-sleeved shirt, and rolled-up pants. Facial features are outlined, and there are no visible accessories. The sketch is against a plain background with red marks in the top corners.

artworks.title: A Gothic Ruin
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a historical stone building with archway architecture and a tall cylindrical structure rising from it. The sketch shows a low horizon with ruins and sketchy trees to the right. Delicate pencil strokes create a light effect, defining the ruins and foliage. The monochromatic grayscale palette emphasizes line and shading for depth. The building is detailed while the distant parts and trees fade into the background.

artworks.title: Bien venu qui apporte
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a portly man standing in profile on a doorstep. He faces a partially opened door with a face peering out from behind it. The man wears a tall top hat tilted forward, casting a shadow over his eyes, and has a prominent nose and a slight smile. He is dressed in a dark jacket, a light waistcoat, and lighter pants, and holds a bundle in his right arm. Behind him is another figure descending the stairs, mostly obscured. The background includes a visible door frame, a curtain, and a simple indoor setting.

artworks.title: Garden Turns, Westmorland
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Mrs. Benjamin Ogle Tayloe, 1879)
artworks.description: The image depicts a garden with meticulously trimmed hedges leading to a historic estate. The horizon is hidden by the hedges and the grand house in the background. The sky is clear with wispy clouds. The painting is detailed, showing the textures of the trees and the clothing of the figures on the path. The color scheme consists of warm earth tones, rich greens, and soft yellows and reds. Two ladies in elegant dresses are walking on the path with a gentleman. More figures can be seen in the distance, enhancing the grandness of the garden.

artworks.title: Studies of Children at Play
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two children interacting closely. One child is crouched on the ground while the other is leaning over them with their arms around the first child's shoulders. Both children have youthful expressions and delicate hair details. The child leaning over has a partially visible face, while the other child has short hair and a smiling expression. The clothing is suggested with loose outlines. In the background, there are smaller sketch studies of children's heads and figures with playful details. The sketches are done on a plain paper surface.

artworks.title: Un homme sans asile ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man in full-body profile standing with his legs slightly apart. He is facing to the right, with his head tilted downward. The man has pronounced facial features including a long nose and a pointed chin. He wears a tall, slightly crumpled hat that mostly covers his hair, a long coat, a shirt, snug-fitting trousers, and holds a bundle wrapped in a cloth over his left shoulder. The background features a textured pattern suggesting heavy rainfall, with diagonal streaks resembling rain and patches of ground visible below.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper part of a man's body facing forward. His facial features include a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and thin lips. His sparse hair appears white or light in color. He is wearing a high-collared coat with a large lapel over a shirt. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain with a simple, unadorned surface.

artworks.title: African-American Figure
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing. They are wearing a coat over a buttoned shirt and trousers, with a hat on their head. The person has distinct facial features with slightly raised eyebrows and an open mouth. One hand is relaxed at their side, potentially holding an object. The background is plain and slightly textured.

artworks.title: Les petits présens ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures, a woman and a man. The woman is leaning forward towards the man who is standing upright. The woman has an upturned pointy nose, small rounded eyes, hair styled in a bun with a ribbon on top, and is wearing a long patterned dress, pointed shoes. The man has large wide eyes, a prominent pointed nose, and short hair with a middle part. He is dressed in a dark jacket, pants, shoes, with a scarf around his neck, holding a wallet. The background is plain with shading beneath their feet and text at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Rocks
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of large, weathered rocks with delicate pencil strokes to suggest texture and shadows, drawn on beige-toned paper in monochrome shades of pencil gray. Tufts of grass are interspersed among the rocks.
